entries.title: Animal Well

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has the complete game in a native release with PC capture/settings flexibility. The Switch, PS5, and Xbox Series versions are documented access routes, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy ANIMAL WELL on Steam for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with capture/settings flexibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete version with the best archive/capture route.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable console release; enhanced visual effects are present when played on Nintendo Switch 2.
all_releases.reason: skip: excellent portable route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.
skip: strong console route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.
skip: later console route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or content-expanded edition is documented; the Nintendo Switch version has Switch 2 visual-enhancement compatibility, but that does not add gameplay content.
